copy.tagline: 路由 ACP agent 请求到后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 系统中进行请求路由
copy.tagline_en: Route ACP agent requests to the backend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to route agent requests in your system

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会优先使用配置好的CrawClaw ACP agent定义来处理请求，而不是直接执行适配器命令。ACP会话会保持非交互模式，并依据配置的权限策略运作，不再弹出内部提示。同时，Claude会从acpx插件的配置中读取专门的MCP服务器列表。
howto.when: 当用户明确提到“ACP agent”、“ACP session”或“acpx backend”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我调用ACP agent处理这个任务。
为ACP会话设置权限为全部批准。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will prioritize configured CrawClaw ACP agent definitions over raw adapter commands. ACP sessions will be non-interactive, using the configured permission policy instead of prompting. It will also read ACP-local MCP servers from the acpx plugin config.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when a request explicitly targets ACP agents, ACP sessions, or the acpx backend.

say_en.text: Use the ACP agent for this task.
say_en.note: Claude will use the configured CrawClaw agent.

say_en.text: Set ACP session permissions to approve all.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the approve-all mode.
